correctness.rationale: For odd p and d≥2 with p not dividing d−1, W: y^p−y=x f(x^{p−1}) is a connected Artin–Schreier cover of degree p and pole degree M=1+(p−1)d prime to p; standard one-pole AS ramification gives genus (p−1)(M−1)/2. Scalar Fp× acts on (x,y), and invariant u=x^{p−1},v=y/x give C: u v^p−v=f(u), with total scalar ramification at (0,0) and ∞. Tame Riemann–Hurwitz gives g(C)=(p−1)d/2 and unique P∞ over u∞. The polynomials uv^j=x^{p−1−j}y^j give one-pole orders p+j(d−1); the Apéry set mod p of the generated semigroup is {0}∪{p+j(d−1):1≤j<p}. Its gap genus equals g(C), proving semigroup equality, all p minimal generators, Frobenius (p−1)(d−1), conductor +1 and pseudo-Frobenius {j(d−1)}. A second place over u=0 has ramification index p−1 while [k(C):k(u)]=p, proving that projection non-Galois for odd p. Uses normalization and algebraic closure, not a finite-field point-count claim.
